title: Aubergine with Potato Mash
instructions: Wash the aubergine properly. Cut it into identical halves and score the inside into little cubes, as you would a mango.
Rub some olive oil on top and into the ridges, season with herbs and salt.
Insert into Remoska (preferred) or baking dish, cubed-side up, skin-side down, and bake for about 15 minutes.
Take tomatoes and cut them into thin circles.
Once the aubergine got some color, layer the tomatoes on top in a thin layer and season again, continue baking.
Once the tomatoes got some color, layer slices of cheese on top and bake again until golden.
